definitions.gloss: large capacity; high capacity; high volume
definitions.explanation: Having a large storage capacity or volume. Commonly used for electronic devices, batteries, containers, and data storage.

examples.japanese: {大容量|だいようりょう}のバッテリーを{搭載|とうさい}している。
examples.english: It is equipped with a large-capacity battery.

examples.japanese: {大容量|だいようりょう}のハードディスクに{買|か}い{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I replaced it with a high-capacity hard drive.

examples.japanese: {大容量|だいようりょう}のモバイルバッテリーがあれば、{旅行|りょこう}{中|ちゅう}も{安心|あんしん}だ。
examples.english: With a high-capacity portable charger, you can feel at ease during travel.

notes:
A compound of {大|だい} (large) and {容量|ようりょう} (capacity/volume). Very frequently used as a modifier in product descriptions and advertising, especially for electronics and tech products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大容量|だいようりょう}バッテリー — large-capacity battery
- {大容量|だいようりょう}ファイル — large file
- {大容量|だいようりょう}データ — large data, big data
- {大容量|だいようりょう}モデル — high-capacity model

RELATED WORDS:
- {小容量|しょうようりょう} — small capacity (the opposite)
- {容量|ようりょう} — capacity, volume (base word)
- {大量|たいりょう} — large quantity (refers to amount, not storage capacity)
